title: 第1540章 无知己消失第1539章 世界意志不可撼动
content_zh:
道陨全部的本源之力，代表着世界的最终意志，法则之罚本身，它的出现是如此神圣耀眼，无法撼动，如此的无边无际，然在这神圣之下，并没有希望与救赎，反而自带的极端暴虐的天气，伴随着死亡与无限恐怖，整个青天世界摇摇欲坠，仿佛在下一刻就会坍塌。
苍穹撕裂，大地巨震，飓风倾覆之下，一切趋于湮灭态，无数只手眼，对青天世界的所有生灵发难，无一生灵事物幸免。
“所有天神，这是法则之罚的本质，只要清除了它，所有灾劫会在顷刻间结束”昭光道，他与无知己联手，在法则之罚本源内毫无顾忌地全力出手，摧毁一些法则之罚的本源之力，但昭光自身力量也受到侵蚀与损害，最强大的光道杀招，用过一次之后就遭到强行禁用，剩下的光道杀招，虽然非人不熟且也掺杂了一些天外之力，但效果就没有那么好了。
面对法则之罚本源，昭光第一次感受到了无计可施，纯粹的世界力量，只会不断的增长，没有任何衰竭的可能，除非八大界彻底毁灭，否则法则之法的本源力量像是无穷无尽。
无知己的意志在引爆界外虚空之后，他的本体就间接取回了被普化规则之力封印的力量，可以重新召唤出灭神之剑，这是无知己睥睨苍穹，傲视群雄的最强杀伐手段，碾压全部天神的断层力量，这股力量，在法罚之罚本源上留下成百上千道难以恢复的界外虚空吞噬空间，一时间，比昭光灭掉的法者之法本源的有生力量更多一些。
“法则之罚本源，竟然会主动现身，诸位，你们能大展身手的时机到了，为了青天世界，为了你们自己的胜利而战，一个个的，可千万不要害怕的尿裤子哦”无知己调侃地说道，这些天神们一个个的把青天世界为己任挂在嘴边，不知道在真正身死与绝望面前，能否还保持着先前的态度。他与昭光在法则之罚本源面前的战斗持续数天，算不上轻松，也算不上太狼狈，中规中矩，无知己真正接触到法则之罚的力量果然与他预估的一样，如同界主亲临，甚至在某些方面超越界主，这就对了，毕竟这是逆反世界所有规则的逆天之举，不可能没有惩罚。
“我辈之责，义不容辞，还轮不到你这始作俑者来评说”成挚道，他与剩下八位长老，指挥控制着八大超级法器辅助配合他们战斗，直击法则之罚本源核心，就是高挂在高天的那一颗裂缝之眼，裂缝之眼好似有无数道光翼簇拥，就像盛开的花瓣中的花蕊。
黑漆的界外虚空“棺材”外，超级法器九龙横立，起先立马引得八大宗众神的疑惑，随后吞天真君一番传音解释，原来这法器是属于那个应无悔的，而这座超级法器内，有一名天神，以及龙人琉璃。
九龙释放出燃灭一刻以后已经力竭，又受到攻击应无悔的道陨本源攻击，九龙本身有一半以的的能力不能释放，异能倚仗的就是它作为超级法器本身的强度，可以充当肉盾。
“无悔，我一直都会在你身边守护好你的”琉璃道。
“不论是抵挡不住法则自罚本源的攻势，以及应无悔自己无法完全炼化开创出界外之道而遭受反噬死亡或者波及无辜，应无悔都交代过，都要以你的安全为第一准则”雨红道，他只依照应无悔的意志行事，应无悔让他做什么，他就一定会执行。
“我不允许你说这些丧气的话，我的无悔一定会成功的”琉璃当即说道。
爻变在浴血厮杀中莫名其妙地就从界外虚空当中被传送出来，而后就见到八大宗与万界庭与界外虚空的罪魁祸首无知己“握手言和”的画面，他立马通过八大宗内部信息了解到当下全部情况，既震惊愤怒又无可奈何。
与爻变一起传送出来的天神人数不足两百，他们大多数人的状态，是不如爻变的。
爻变进入到界外虚空当中时，也曾时刻担忧着他的两位亲传弟子的安危，但在界外虚空刚爆发的时候，爻变就叮嘱他们——点到为止，尽己所能即可，谁知道这样的劝告对两位倔强的弟子来说根本无用，知珩受了极为严重的伤，他没有管那么多，那怕是这里即将要被法则之罚本源毁灭，也没有他去见弟子重要。
爻变迅急地进入玉壶犀角，随后就是见到成盛等人以及他们的弟子们，他们的弟子情况也不容乐观，但和完全无法苏醒过来的知珩比起来好上太多。
八大超级法器之间相互连通，可以相互传送，如今玉壶犀角内有数千名以上天神不断来往，伤势轻微或者伤势较重，亦或者在这里死去以及刚到这里，来不及治疗，就暴毙而亡，八大法器的操控，至少总共有数万名天神，法器本身受到损害，一般不会伤及天神，只有天神主动出去战斗，脱离了超级法器的加持庇护，才会导致直接伤亡，但法则之罚本源一出现，庞大的超级法器，并非无孔不入，当超级法器某个部件损坏到一定程度，来自法则之罚本源的入侵攻击就来了，当下青天世界当中，没有一处绝对安全，哪怕是隐藏在类似福地洞天的额外特殊空间世界，依然逃不掉法则之罚本源的制裁。
知珩昏迷，由知瑜在一旁照看，爻变立刻上前，查探知珩的身体状况。
“师尊，您去哪里了，另五位师尊他们早就从外虚空当中出来”知瑜道。
知珩的气息在不可逆的衰败，爻变对此束手无策。

“怎么会变成这样，知珩？”爻变问道，他想知道自己的爱徒知珩到底是经历了什么事情，他身上有极其浓重的界外虚空力量
“是贰型虚道兽，知珩为了保护众人，一直勇敢地冲锋在第一线，受到贰型的致命重创，仍然要站着继续战斗，直到力竭，意识模糊，为什么不想一想自己，想一想我这位亲姐姐，所以……”知瑜说着说着便伤心心疼起来，这可是她的唯一的亲弟弟，以前再怎数落与调侃甚至是动起手来揍他，那都是小打小闹，是对他弟弟的关切，现在她真的想让知珩醒来，哪怕是令伤痛转移到她这位姐姐身上，也不要在继续折磨他这位弟弟了。
“知瑜，知珩很勇敢，他是我们的骄傲，他按照自己的想法保全了伙伴，所以他做的没有错”爻变拍了拍知瑜的肩膀，“师尊会和你一起守护知珩，直到他醒过来为止”
尘牧等五位同门，让爻变加入大战，可爻变只用一句话回绝了他们：“任何事，任何人，都没有我的爱徒重要！”
璨金珐琅。
content_en:
All the original power of Dao Yun represents the ultimate will of the world, the punishment of the law itself. Its appearance is so sacred and dazzling that it cannot be shaken and is so boundless. However, under this sacredness, there is no hope and salvation. Instead, it comes with extremely violent weather, accompanied by death and infinite terror. The entire blue sky world is crumbling, as if it will collapse in the next moment.
The sky is torn, the earth is shaken, and the hurricane is overturning. Everything tends to be annihilated. Countless hands and eyes attack all living creatures in the blue sky world, and no living thing is spared.
"All gods, this is the essence of the punishment of the law. As long as it is eliminated, all disasters will end in an instant," Zhaoguang said. He joined forces with Wuji and used all his strength to destroy some of the origins of the punishment of the law without any scruples. However, Zhaoguang's own strength has also been eroded and damaged. The most powerful light path killing move was forcibly banned after being used once. The remaining light path killing moves, although not familiar to humans and mixed with some extraterrestrial power, are not as effective.
Facing the source of the punishment of the law, Zhaoguang felt for the first time that there was nothing he could do. The pure power of the world would only continue to grow without any possibility of exhaustion. Unless the eight worlds were completely destroyed, the original power of the law seemed to be endless.
After Wuzhi's will detonated the void outside the world, his body indirectly regained the power sealed by the power of universal rules, and could re-summon the God-Destroying Sword. This is Wuzhi's strongest killing method that looks at the sky and dominates the crowd. , the fault power that crushed all the gods, this power left hundreds of unrecoverable outer void swallowing spaces on the origin of the punishment of the law. For a time, it was more living power than the origin of the law of the law that Zhaoguang destroyed.
"The source of the punishment of the law will actually take the initiative to show up. Everyone, the time has come for you to show off your skills. Fight for the Blue Sky World and for your own victory. One by one, don't be afraid to pee your pants." Wuxian said jokingly. These gods all talk about the Blue Sky World as their mission. I don't know if they can maintain their previous attitude in the face of real death and despair. The battle between him and Zhao Guang in front of the origin of the Punishment of the Law lasted for several days. It was neither easy nor too embarrassing. It was quite satisfactory. The power of Wuxian who really came into contact with the Punishment of the Law was exactly as he expected. It was like the Lord of the World coming in person, and even surpassing the Lord of the World in some aspects. This was right. After all, this was an act of defiance against all the rules of the world, and there was no way there would be no punishment.
"It is my duty to take responsibility, and it is not your turn to comment as the instigator." Cheng Zhi said. He and the remaining eight elders commanded and controlled eight super magic weapons to assist them in fighting, directly striking at the core of the source of the punishment of the law, which is the eye of the crack hanging high in the sky. The eye of the crack seems to be surrounded by countless light wings, just like the stamens in the petals of a blooming flower.
Outside the black void "coffin", the super magic weapon Nine Dragons stood horizontally. At first, it immediately aroused the doubts of the gods of the eight sects. Later, Lord Tun Tianzhen explained through a voice transmission that it turned out that this magic weapon belonged to Ying Wuhui, and inside this super magic weapon, there was a god and Dragon Man Liuli.
Jiulong was exhausted a moment after releasing Burning, and was attacked by Dao Yun's source of attack Ying Wuhui. More than half of Jiulong's own abilities could not be released. The super power relied on its strength as a super magic weapon, which could act as a human shield.
"Wu regrets, I will always be by your side to protect you," Liuli said.
"Whether it is unable to withstand the offensive of the self-punishment source of the law, or whether Ying Wuhui cannot fully refine and create a way out of the world and suffers backlash and death or affects innocent people, Ying Wuhui has already explained that your safety must be the first criterion," Yu Hong said. He only acts according to Ying Wuhui's will. Whatever Ying Wuhui asks him to do, he will definitely do it.OK.
"I don't allow you to say these depressing words. My No Regrets will definitely succeed," Liuli said immediately.
Yao Bian was inexplicably teleported out of the void outside the boundary during the bloody fight, and then saw the scene of Wuji, the culprit of the Eight Great Sects, the Court of All Worlds, and the void outside the boundary "shaking hands and making peace." He immediately learned the entire situation through the internal information of the Eight Great Sects, and was shocked, angry, and helpless.
The number of gods sent out with Yao Bian was less than two hundred, and most of them were in worse condition than Yao Bian.
When Yao Bian entered the void outside the boundary, he was always worried about the safety of his two direct disciples. However, when the void outside the boundary first broke out, Yao Bian warned them - just stop there and do your best. Who knows? Dao's advice was of no use to the two stubborn disciples. Zhiheng was seriously injured and he didn't care so much. Even if the place was about to be destroyed by the source of the punishment of the law, it was not as important as him seeing the disciples.
Yaobian quickly entered the Yuhu Rhinoceros Horn, and then saw Cheng Sheng and others and their disciples. The situation of their disciples was not optimistic, but it was much better than Zhiheng who could not wake up at all.
The eight super magic weapons are connected to each other and can be transmitted to each other. Nowadays, more than thousands of gods are constantly coming and going in the jade pot and rhinoceros horn. They are slightly injured or seriously injured, or they die here or just after arriving here, without time for treatment. There are at least tens of thousands of gods in control of the eight magic weapons. If the magic weapon itself is damaged, it usually does not hurt the gods. Only the gods take the initiative to fight and escape from the super. Only the blessing and protection of the magic weapon will lead to direct casualties. However, once the source of the punishment of the law appears, the huge super magic weapon is not pervasive. When a certain part of the super magic weapon is damaged to a certain extent, an invasion attack from the source of the punishment of the law will come. In the current blue sky world, no place is absolutely safe. Even if it is hidden in an additional special space world like the blessed land, it still cannot escape the sanction of the source of the punishment of the law.
Zhiheng was unconscious, and Zhiyu was taking care of him. Yaobian immediately stepped forward to check Zhiheng's physical condition.
"Master, where have you been? The other five masters have long come out of the outer void," Zhiyu said.
Zhiheng's aura is irreversibly declining, and Yao Bian is helpless.
“怎么会变成这样，知珩？”爻变问道，他想知道自己的爱徒知珩到底是经历了什么事情，他身上有极其浓重的界外虚空力量
“是贰型虚道兽，知珩为了保护众人，一直勇敢地冲锋在第一线，受到贰型的致命重创，仍然要站着继续战斗，直到力竭，意识模糊，为什么不想一想自己，想一想我这位亲姐姐，所以……”知瑜说着说着便伤心心疼起来，这可是她的唯一的亲弟弟，以前再怎数落与调侃甚至是动起手来揍他，那都是小打小闹，是对他弟弟的关切，现在她真的想让知珩醒来，哪怕是令伤痛转移到她这位姐姐身上，也不要在继续折磨他这位弟弟了。
"Zhiyu, Zhiheng is very brave. He is our pride. He protected his friends according to his own ideas, so what he did was right." Yaobian patted Zhiyu on the shoulder, "Master will protect Zhiheng with you until he wakes up."
Chen Mu and other five disciples asked Yao Bian to join the war, but Yao Bian rejected them with just one sentence: "Nothing or anyone is as important as my beloved disciple!"
